 Inspiration 

 I had this idea a long time ago to create a worms/civilization mix game, but never had the time to really flesh it out. 

 What it does 

 It's a fun game. Especially fun to play against agents. 

 How I built it 

 Only using AI, but far from a one shot. 

 Challenges I ran into 

 MCP using a lot of tokens, had to improve the protocol a lot to allow the agents to react fast in this time limit / round based game. 

 Accomplishments that we're proud of 

 Just playing a match against an agent is quite fun. Really cool was letting the agent play against the AI and then refelcting on how mcp and the game ai could be improved. 

 What I learned 

 A lot is possible with AI but clearly communicating intent is important. 

 What's next for Beaver Krieg 

 Polish it and release it to the public. 

 What did i do during this hackathon 

 Implement the MCP protocol and then implemented WebMCP. Which in my case fit perfectly, since now there is no complicated mcp setup for the user, he can just paste the invite link and can play against an agent.
